notes: Created initial story set for Proximity to User (distance + travel time).

EVAL-CT-M3-S1.title: Define Proximity Schema and Contract
EVAL-CT-M3-S1.description: Define structured schema for trial site proximity including distance (miles/km), travel duration (minutes), and origin/destination metadata.

EVAL-CT-M3-S2.title: Implement Distance and Travel Time Calculation Logic
EVAL-CT-M3-S2.description: Implement logic to compute distance and estimated travel time between user location and each clinical trial site using normalized inputs.

EVAL-CT-M3-S3.title: Integrate Google Routes API for Travel Metrics
EVAL-CT-M3-S3.description: Integrate Google Routes API to fetch real-world travel distance and duration, including handling API errors, rate limits, and missing location data.

EVAL-CT-M3-S4.title: Expose Proximity Data via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-CT-M3-S4.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to include proximity metrics in clinical trial results returned to the chat experience.

EVAL-CT-M3-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Proximity Calculation
EVAL-CT-M3-S5.description: Create tests validating distance and duration accuracy, handling of missing or invalid locations, and end-to-end integration with clinical trial search results.

EVAL-CT-MEASURE-3.mitigation: Fallback to straight-line distance if Google Routes API fails.
